reading.title: Swim Class Day
reading.purpose: Hear two people talk about big feelings.
paras: Tomás says, "I feel nervous. Swim class is new." Mama says, "Take a slow breath. You can be calm." Mama holds his hand.
Tomás says, "I was worried, but now I am excited!" Mama says, "I am proud of you." Tomás jumps in with a big smile.

qs.q: Tomás feels nervous. What does nervous mean?
choices: A little scared about something new.
qs.why: Swim class is new, and Tomás feels a little scared.
Mama says, "I am proud of you."

qs.q: How does Tomás feel at the end?

reading.retellFrame: Tomás felt ___, and then he felt ___.
